text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali receives annual report of Administrative Court.
- Parliament approves a municipalities fiscal code.
- Tunisia has 40 civil servants for 1,000 inhabitants, Secretary of State for Reform of the Administration says.
- Interior Minister Mohamed Jegham says: "Our mission is to be in the service of the citizens and to safeguard the country's invulnerability".
- Parliamentarians say democracy, development, security and stability are linked.
- Secretary of State for Information Fethi Houidi tells parliament that government supports freedom of the press.
